title: Today’s observations. Tomorrow’s fire map.
goal: Identify exactly what enters a forecast and what its target means.
deliverable: An annotated forecast timeline and input/target contract.

short: From channels to a fire map
title: How does a model paint a fire map?
goal: Follow a satellite sample through features, logits and a pixel prediction.
deliverable: An annotated tensor diagram and a probability-to-mask calculation.

title: Almost every pixel is background. Now what?
goal: Explain false alarms, missed fire and why one accuracy number is insufficient.
deliverable: A metric worksheet and a fixed evaluation plan.

title: Your first complete wildfire experiment.
goal: Move from setup to a verified official Fold 2 result, one gate at a time.
deliverable: A Fold 2 experiment record with completion evidence.

title: No fire, or no observation?
goal: Understand controlled missingness and make the transition to the project protocol.
deliverable: A scenario sheet and a project-readiness checklist.

title: The score improved. Did the method help?
goal: Separate ordinary continuation from a new training choice.
deliverable: A matched foundation / ERM plan and an A/B result report.

title: Change the schedule. Keep the comparison.
goal: Test cosine-schedule continuation against a matched ERM control.
deliverable: An A/B/C comparison with a schedule-specific conclusion.

title: One generalist, or several specialists?
goal: Distinguish specialist performance, system routing and the cost of extra models.
deliverable: A matched specialist comparison and a follow-up proposal.
